input: Find bootstrapped European vertical SaaS companies for logistics or freight with 50-200 employees

companies.name: Riege Software International GmbH
companies.traction: 900+ customers worldwide with 16,000+ users in 60 countries per LinkedIn About (incl. Dachser, DB Schenker, Kerry Logistics, Logwin); 550+ forwarders/airlines/manufacturers in 41 countries per press kit; revenue EUR 12m annual (index profile)
companies.employees: 120+ employees per company press kit (undated, page live as of 2026-11-09); LinkedIn band 51-200 with 101 employees on LinkedIn (as_of 2026-11-09)
companies.ownership: Family-owned, founder-owned - internationally operating family business led by the Riege family (Christian, Gabriele, Dr. Tobias Riege); no VC/PE investment found on any checked page
companies.last_round: None found - no funding round disclosed on LinkedIn profile or company press kit
companies.rank_reason: Strongest fit: four decades of founder/family ownership with zero external funding, pure-play SaaS TMS (Scope) for air/ocean freight and customs, employees solidly inside the 50-200 band with dated growth from 70 (2019) to 120+ (2026), and the broadest verified traction (900+ customers, 60 countries)
companies.headcount_growth: 70 employees (beginning of 2019) -> ~100 (interview, published ~Feb 2024) -> 101 on LinkedIn and 120+ in company press kit (as_of 2026-11-09)

criteria_evidence.evidence: Headquartered in Meerbusch, Germany, with subsidiaries in NL, CH, USA, Mexico, Hong Kong, Singapore
Scope is a SaaS transport management system for air freight, ocean freight and customs, cloud-based freight-forwarding software
Press kit fact table: 'Employees | 120 +'; LinkedIn company size 51-200 with 101 employees on LinkedIn (as_of 2026-11)
Founded 1985 by Johannes Riege and run as a family business by four Riege siblings; 'privately-owned and managed'; no funding round or investor ever disclosed on company or LinkedIn pages

companies.name: Translogica GmbH
companies.traction: Rhenus rollout of translogica TMS live at pilot site Unna with Moenchengladbach next (LinkedIn post, Nov 2026); 250+ intelligent workflows developed; exhibitor at TransLogistica Warsaw
companies.employees: approx. 170 employees per company website (as_of 2026-11-09); LinkedIn shows 73 employees in the 51-200 band (as_of 2026-11-09) - count discrepancy noted
companies.ownership: Privately held; no VC/PE funding found. Austrian registry lists shareholders as InfPro IT Solutions GmbH and Bernhard Heuschneider (directory data, older than 1 year); founded as an academic spin-off of the University of Innsbruck
companies.last_round: None found - no funding round disclosed on company site, LinkedIn profile or registry pages
companies.rank_reason: Clean fit on geography (Austria), vertical (TMS + document management for freight forwarders) and headcount (~170 per own site, inside 50-200); bootstrapped status is inferred from absence of any funding/PE/VC record rather than a positive statement, and the 73-vs-170 employee discrepancy between LinkedIn and the company site is unresolved, so it ranks below Riege
companies.headcount_growth: Not determinable - only one reliable dated count each from company site (~170, 2026) and LinkedIn (73, 2026-11); no second dated count found

criteria_evidence.evidence: Headquarters Innsbruck, Austria; six locations incl. Vienna, Kempten, Hamburg, Duesseldorf, Warsaw
Transport and Document Management System (TDMS) translogica/dotiga for Speditionen (freight forwarders) and logistics companies
Company site: 'Heute beschaeftigen wir ca. 170 hoch qualifizierte Mitarbeitende an sechs Standorten' (as_of 2026-11-09); LinkedIn: 73 employees, band 51-200

Founded 2004 as academic spin-off of University of Innsbruck; 'Kontinuitaet, solides Wachstum' philosophy; no investor, funding round or PE/VC ownership on company, LinkedIn or Austrian registry pages

companies.name: Setlog GmbH
companies.traction: OSCA supply chain software used by more than 150 brands worldwide incl. Karl Lagerfeld, Tom Tailor, Gerry Weber, S.Oliver; member of BVL, Logistik.NRW, Open Logistics Foundation; 2026 x4OSCA integration with Microsoft Dynamics 365
companies.employees: LinkedIn band 51-200 with 49 profiles on LinkedIn (as_of 2026-11-09); company press release states 'more than 50 employees' (as of 2021-07-26)
companies.ownership: Founder-owned - founded 2001 by Guido Brackelsberg, Ralf Duester and Jakob Gielen; founding partners still lead the company (with managing director Dmitry Chaykin); 'Privately Held' on LinkedIn; no VC/PE investment found
companies.last_round: None found - no funding round disclosed on company site or LinkedIn
companies.rank_reason: Founder-owned European supply-chain/logistics SaaS with strong named-brand traction, but ranked last because its headcount sits at the very bottom edge of the 50-200 band (49-51 on LinkedIn; '>50' statement dates from 2021), so the criterion is met only marginally
companies.headcount_growth: More than 50 employees (company press release, 2021-07-26) -> LinkedIn band 51-200 with 49 listed profiles (2026-11-09)

criteria_evidence.evidence: HQ Bochum, Germany; further offices Cologne (DE) and New York (Setlog Corp., founded 2011)

Cloud-based supply chain and logistics software OSCA (OSCA Logistics, Freight Tender Management, Procurement, SRM, CSR, QC); LinkedIn industry Software Development, specialties include Logistics Software and Freight Tender Management
LinkedIn company size 51-200 (as_of 2026-11-09); 2021 company press release: software house 'with more than 50 employees'
Founded and still led by the three founding partners; 'Privately Held' per LinkedIn; no investor, funding or PE/VC ownership mentioned on company site or LinkedIn

output.search_notes: Thesis: private, bootstrapped (no VC/PE), European vertical SaaS for logistics/freight, 50-200 employees. As_of 2026-11-09. Qualifying: Riege Software (Meerbusch DE, family-owned, 120+ emp), Translogica (Innsbruck AT, ~170 emp per own site), Setlog (Bochum DE, founder-owned, ~50 emp, borderline). Verified exclusions: Wanko Informationslogistik (Ainring DE, ~100-130 emp, family since 1972) - majority-acquired by PE firm Main Capital Partners 2022 (FleetGO Group); active logistics (Herdecke/Koblenz DE, ~180 emp) - subsidiary of proLogistik Group, which is PE-backed by Elvaston Capital (2021); CtrlChain (Eindhoven NL, 76 emp) - raised USD 3.07m seed (last round 2021-10), VC-funded; cargo.one (Berlin) - VC-backed, USD 84m incl. Series B (Bessemer) and 2026 round; Sirum GmbH (Hamburg) - only 29-35 employees, below band despite bootstrapping; FiLogic (Haarlem NL) - self-funded but 'compact team', no verifiable headcount; Cargoson (Tallinn) - 14 employees; DAKOSY (Hamburg) - 230 employees, above band; Akanea (Lyon FR) - 270-300 employees and part of Isagri Group; Soloplan (~600), LIS AG (~350), AEB (~750), TimoCom (~600) - above band; Alpega - PE (Castik Capital); Transporeon - owned by Trimble; ICOS Group - Auckland, New Zealand, not European; CargoON (Wroclaw) - part of Trans.eu Group. Employee counts marked as_of date of the cited page. Ranking rationale: Riege ranks first for clean fit on all four criteria plus strongest traction; Translogica second (headcount solid but ownership inferred and LinkedIn/site discrepancy); Setlog third (headcount at band edge).
